title: Xiaomi Redmi Note 17 in for review
description: Today we have with us the new Redmi Note 17, which is the newest member of Xiaomi’s Redmi Note series and the successor to last year’s Redmi Note 15. It is also functionally identical to the Poco M8 Power that was launched recently. The Redmi Note series has always prioritized offering great value by combining premium features with an affordable price. However, things are going to be different this year. The Redmi Note 17 is the latest victim of the ongoing memory crisis thanks to Uncle Sam's invention, and as a result, some of the specifications have been dialed back compared to last...

title: Redmi K100 Pro Max will pack a 9,070mAh battery
description: Ahead of the Redmi K100 Pro series launch on August 11, the company has revealed the battery specifications of the K100 Pro Max. Redmi has also shared official renders of the smartphone in its white color option. Redmi has confirmed that the K100 Pro Max will pack a 9,070mAh battery with support for 100W wired and 50W wireless charging. The smartphone will also support 27W wired reverse charging and 22.5W wireless reverse charging. Redmi had previously revealed that the K100 Pro Max would feature a 6.9-inch AMOLED display with a 185Hz refresh rate and up to 4,500 nits of peak...

title: Redmi Note 17 launched in India with 8000mAh battery and Snapdragon 4 Gen 4
description: Xiaomi has announced the Redmi Note 17 in India. Successor to the Redmi Note 15 from last year, the new model brings a much larger battery capacity and a bigger display, but compromises in other areas to maintain price parity in the current market. The Redmi Note 17 has a new 8000mAh battery, which is 45% bigger than the one on the Redmi Note 15. You get 45W of wired fast charging as well as 22.5W of reversed wired charging. The new phone also has a bigger (and flatter) 7.0-inch 120Hz AMOLED display with Corning Gorilla Glass 7i protection. However, concessions have been made...

title: Here's when the Samsung Galaxy S26 series will receive One UI 9 Beta 5
description: Samsung released the first One UI 9 beta update for the Galaxy S26 series in May, with the last beta build for the S26 trio rolled out more than three weeks ago. Beta users have been eagerly waiting for the fifth One UI 9 beta, and Samsung has revealed when it will be released. Samsung Galaxy S26 Ultra A Beta Operations Manager on the Samsung Community Forum said that the One UI 9 Beta 5 update for the Galaxy S26 series is scheduled to release next week without mentioning the date, so expect it to arrive any time between August 10 and 15. title: vivo S2 unveiled, marks the return of the S series to India after a hiatus of 7 years
description: vivo today introduced the vivo S2 in India, marking the comeback of the S series to the Asian country after a hiatus of seven years, as vivo didn't launch any S series smartphone in India after the vivo S1, which was launched in India in August 2019. vivo says the S2 "has been thoughtfully crafted for young consumers who value style, creativity, intelligent experiences, and meaningful innovation," and "with its premium design and advanced imaging capabilities, the vivo S2 delivers a well-rounded experience that complements today’s dynamic lifestyles." title: Samsung's next smartwatch doesn’t run Wear OS, new report claims
description: Samsung is working on a new smartwatch that will not be running Wear OS, according to a new report. This will allegedly slot in between the Galaxy Fit and the Galaxy Watch FE in price, and it's codenamed Galaxy Aero. It runs RTOS and references to it have been found inside the Galaxy Wearable app's code, which describes it as a watch with a screen. It's likely that this will have the standard set of sensors you’d expect from a smartwatch, and given the fact that it's not running Wear OS, it should have week-long (or even weeks-long) battery life. title: vivo V80 Lite 5G is on the way and could be a rebrand job
description: vivo is working on the V80 Lite 5G, the first member of the V80 family, which according to a recent rumor should become official around the middle of this month. The V80 Lite 5G has been spotted in the Google Play Console with the model numbers V2576, V2643, and V2644. Interestingly, the V2576 model number is also listed in the Google Play Console for the vivo S2, which is launching in India on August 6. This situation strongly implies that the V80 Lite 5G will be a rebranded vivo S2 for other markets. If that's the case, then, like the S2, the V80 Lite 5G may have a 6.83-inch...

title: Huawei unveils 2026 MateBook Fold with Kirin X90 Plus SoC
description: Huawei unveiled the MateBook Fold Ultimate Design, its foldable laptop, in May last year, followed by the Extraordinary Master Edition a few months later. The company has now introduced the 2026 MateBook Fold, featuring an upgraded chipset. The 2026 Huawei MateBook Fold Extraordinary Master Edition is powered by the Kirin X90 Plus chipset and can be configured with up to 32GB of RAM and 2TB of storage. While most of the hardware remains unchanged from last year's model, Huawei has refreshed the laptop's design. It retains the 18-inch dual-layer LTPO OLED foldable display that offers...

title: TCL P80 and P80 Pro renders, specs, and prices leak
description: TCL is working on a couple of new smartphones, which it plans to launch in Europe. Official-looking renders of both have been leaked today by a reliable source. The TCL P80 is allegedly powered by the MediaTek Dimensity 7300 Elite chipset, paired with 8GB of RAM and 128GB of storage. It has a 50MP main camera with OIS, an 8MP ultrawide, a 32MP selfie camera, and a 5,000 mAh battery. TCL P80 leaked renders The TCL P80 Pro has a 6.83-inch 1280x2766 OLED Nxtpaper display and the same cameras as the P80, but it's powered by the MediaTek Dimensity 7400 Elite SoC and has a bigger...

title: Huawei launches the feather-light 12-inch MatePad Pro 2026
description: Alongside the nova 16 SE smartphone, today Huawei also announced the MatePad Pro 2026 tablet. It has a 12-inch OLED screen with 3036x1952 resolution and 1,600-nit peak brightness. It's powered by the Kirin T93 or Kirin T93A chipset, depending on the model - the former is built into the standard version, while the latter is reserved for the Enjoy Edition, which is cheaper. The tablet runs HarmonyOS 6.1, and you can have it with 12GB of RAM and 256GB or 512GB of storage. On the rear there's a 50MP f/1.8 main camera, while on the front there's a 12MP f/2.4 selfie shooter. Keeping the...

title: Take a look at the Boltt Ace 5G and Boltt Evo 4G
description: Back in June we first heard that Fire-Boltt would be expanding into the smartphone space, and yesterday the company officially revealed the launch date for its first Boltt smartphones: August 25. Today, the promo page on Flipkart has been updated with the first images of the Boltt Ace 5G and Boltt Evo 4G. None of the main specs have been revealed yet, but we can see that the Ace has three rear cameras, and the page also says it's 9.49mm thick. title: Apple reports over $10 billion in sales in India for the first time
description: Apple has set a new high water mark in India – annual sales in the country topped $10 billion for the full fiscal year for the first time (this was for the 12-month period ending in March). This is up from the $9 billion figure for the previous fiscal year and an impressive 67% growth compared to three years ago. Most of the sales came from the iPhone line, of course, but Apple also saw increased demand for iPads and MacBooks, according to an insider who spoke to Bloomberg. title: Google Assistant is shutting down, here’s when
description: Google is going to be shutting down the Google Assistant service, now that Gemini is taking over. The Google Assistant shutdown will commence on September 4, but it "may take a few weeks" to reach everyone who's still using it. This shutdown will take effect on Android and Wear OS, but also on headphones (since they were using the phone's Google Assistant anyway) and vehicles running Android Auto (since, again, it was basically the Google Assistant on the phone that was being used). On cars with Google built-in (aka running Android Automotive), the Google Assistant will continue to...

title: This is when Google is launching the Pixel Tag and how much it costs
description: According to a new rumor, Google is planning to unveil the Pixel Tag, its first AirTag-like tracker, on August 12, which is also when it's announcing the Pixel 11 series and the Pixel Watch 5. The Pixel Tag will allegedly be priced at €34.99 in the Eurozone, which incidentally is the exact same price as the Apple AirTag. That's obviously not a coincidence. Here's a leaked image of the Pixel Tag: The device will apparently only be offered in a single color, which is called Light Fog. It's unclear if the Pixel Tag will have UWB support, and its specific release date is also unknown....

title: Galaxy Z Fold8 duo and Flip8 exceed Samsung's pre-order targets in Europe
description: Samsung unveiled the Galaxy Z Flip8, the Galaxy Z Fold8, and the Galaxy Z Fold8 Ultra on July 22, and all three of them will go on sale starting August 7. However, like previous models, these foldables are also currently on pre-order in different regions, and they have exceeded Samsung's pre-order targets in Europe. Not just that, Samsung announced that these three new foldables also surpassed total pre-orders for last year's Galaxy Z Fold7 and Galaxy Z Flip7 by 20% year-on-year in Europe in the first 11 days since their July 22 unveiling, with the Fold8 accounting for almost 40% of the...

title: Samsung showcases fast and efficient BV-NAND V10 storage, zHBM for AI accelerators
description: Samsung is showcasing a great variety of memory and storage technologies at its booth at the Future of Memory and Storage (FMS) 2026 event in Santa Clara, California. Thirteen years after it introduced the first V-NAND technology, Samsung is the first to unveil V10 of BV-NAND (Bonded V-NAND). This is a flash memory that has more than 400 layers and leverages Samsung’s advanced bonding technology to stack memory cells. V10 increases memory density by around 58% compared to the previous V9. The higher layer count gives V10 better read, write and I/O performance. It also improves power...

title: SpaceX aims to enter the US telecom market and challenge AT&T, T-Mobile and Verizon
description: During an investor call on Tuesday, SpaceX announced its plans to build a mobile service network and enter the US market. This will put SpaceX in direct competition with AT&T, T-Mobile and Verizon. SpaceX recently acquired 65 MHz wireless spectrum licenses from EchoStar for $19.6 billion, which will help the company expand its mobile services. And since the spectrum purchased from EchoStar has terrestrial components, "the rocket company" plans to use it to build a network and offer a true mobile service. title: WhatsApp introduces new group chat features, including the @all tag
description: WhatsApp has announced new features for group chats, including the @all tag, poll deadlines, and the ability to create a new group chat from an existing one. Let's talk about the polls feature first. WhatsApp now allows users to edit the poll questions within 15 minutes and set an end time to lock voting when the time is up. Users can also hide the voter names so group members feel more comfortable sharing their preferences. Next up is the @all tag, which eliminates the need to tag all group members individually in a message to alert them. However, note that for groups with more...

title: Honor adopts new logo and "Dare to Be" slogan, says it grew 25% in the first quarter of 2026
description: Honor is continuing its push to refresh its brand image with a new logo and a new tagline: “Dare to Be”. This isn’t just a new coat of paint, though. Honor wants users to know that it’s more than just a smartphone company. Part of that is the upcoming Robot Phone, which was recently featured in an event with partner Arri (a famous maker of cinema cameras). This device – part phone, part robot – is part of Honor’s efforts to build intelligent devices – adaptive, interactive machines powered by AI. The company also showcased its AiMAGE technology, which combines on-device image...

title: This is where you can watch the Redmi Note 17 launch
description: Xiaomi has announced the India launch of the Redmi Note 17 5G, which will be taking place tomorrow, on August 6 at 12:00PM IST. This is an online-only event, and will be live-streamed on YouTube. The Redmi Note 17 5G is the latest in Xiaomi's popular Redmi Note series of phones, and the successor to last year's Redmi Note 15 5G. Key features of this new device include an 8000mAh battery, 120Hz AMOLED display with Corning Gorilla Glass 7i protection, 50MP camera on the back, and finally the Qualcomm Snapdragon 4 Gen 4 chipset. The phone should go on sale some time later this...
